change: Consolidated hardened M3 RAM-boot build fixing every runtime failure observed on physical RSD0614 V1.0 in v5.6.1: (1) program RTL8367S (0x6367) max-frame length CFG0/CFG1 (0x088c/0x088d) = 0x0610 (1552B) and select CFG0 in 0x1200[14:13]=0x6000 & 0x0884[1:0]=0x0003 in BOTH rtl8367s_cpu_tag_enable() and rtl8367b_setup() (fixes 1522B truncation of 1526B CPU-tag+802.1Q full-MTU TCP segments that hung LuCI JS and SSH KEXINIT while preserving swconfig apply); (2) stop _New_swNic_send from clobbering CPUICR bit 29 (BUSBURST_128WORDS), linearize nonlinear TX SKBs in rtl819x_eth_xmit, set SoC MACCR CF_FCDSC=0x48, and align USEDDSC pressure/stall threshold from 256 to 400 (< SBFCR1 FCOFF=400, eliminating false PRESSURE spam and false 5s RX-STALL WEDGE resets at normal 3-unplugged-port USEDDSC=345); (3) enable _INCLUDE_PROC_FS_ on Linux 4.14 (/proc/wlan0 & /proc/wlan1), switch rtl8192cd.sh device existence checks from /proc/.../mib_all to /sys/class/net/... (fixes NO_DEVICE abort that left wlan0/wlan1 DOWN and hid RSD0614-OpenWrt-5G/2G), add SET_NETDEV_DEV, and extend 8814B TX reclaim kick; (4) wire AP-safe rtl_giwname for SIOCGIWNAME (iwconfig), populate LuCI wireless.js modes/widths/channels + empty-save guard for rtl8192cd, set vm.min_free_kbytes=2048 for 64 MiB DDR2, and add rsd0614-survey net/diag; all 6 MTDs stay read-only, pcie1/LEDs disabled, persistent flash NO-GO
